workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq] Starlette: request.form() limits silently ignored for application/x-www-form-urlencoded enable DoS (Affects starlette < 1.3.1)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade starlette to patched release >= 1.3.1: pip install --upgrade 'starlette>=1.3.1' (Advisory: GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-jp82-jpqv-5vv3] Starlette: Unvalidated request path concatenated into authority poisons request.url.hostname (Affects starlette < 1.3.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade starlette to patched release >= 1.3.0: pip install --upgrade 'starlette>=1.3.0' (Advisory: GHSA-jp82-jpqv-5vv3)

workarounds.workaround: Upgrade starlette to patched release >= 1.1.0: pip install --upgrade 'starlette>=1.1.0' (Advisory: GHSA-wqp7-x3pw-xc5r)
